FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" = 'Law and Constitutional Studies';

SELECT e."expense_description"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE b."remaining" = (
    SELECT MIN(b2."remaining"::NUMERIC)
    FROM "budget" b2
);

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, i.source
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
ORDER BY i.amount DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m."last_name", mj."department", mj."college"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" = 'Environmental Engineering';

SELECT m."first_name", m."last_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
GROUP BY m."member_id", m."first_name", m."last_name"
ORDER BY MAX(e."cost") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE b."category" = 'Parking'
GROUP BY e."event_id", e."event_name"
HAVING SUM(b."spent") < (
    SELECT SUM(b2."spent") / COUNT(DISTINCT b2."link_to_event")
    FROM "budget" b2
    WHERE b2."category" = 'Parking'
)
ORDER BY e."event_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT m."phone"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" maj ON m."link_to_major" = maj."major_id"
WHERE maj."major_name" = 'Business'
  AND maj."college" = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences';

SELECT DISTINCT z."city", z."state"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
JOIN "zip_code" z ON m."zip" = z."zip_code"
WHERE mj."department" ILIKE '%Electrical and Computer Engineering%'
  AND m."position" = 'Member'
ORDER BY z."city" ASC NULLS FIRST, z."state" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE e."type" <> 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e."event_id", e."event_name"
HAVING COUNT(a."link_to_member") > 20;

SELECT DISTINCT m."first_name", m."last_name", mj."major_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "major" mj ON mj."major_id" = m."link_to_major"
WHERE e."cost"::NUMERIC > 100
ORDER BY m."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, m."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, mj."major_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date"::timestamp) = 2019 THEN b."spent" ELSE 0 END), 0)
  - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date"::timestamp) = 2020 THEN b."spent" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS spent_difference
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date"::timestamp) IN (2019, 2020);

SELECT m."first_name", m."last_name", e."event_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "event" e ON e."event_id" = a."link_to_event"
WHERE m."first_name" ILIKE 'Maya'
  AND m."last_name" ILIKE 'Mclean'
  AND e."event_name" ILIKE 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT e."cost"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
JOIN "event" ev ON b."link_to_event" = ev."event_id"
WHERE e."expense_description" ILIKE '%Posters%'
  AND ev."event_name" ILIKE '%September Speaker%';

SELECT m."last_name"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "event" e ON e."event_id" = a."link_to_event"
WHERE m."position" = 'Member'
  AND e."event_name" ILIKE '%Women%s Soccer%';

SELECT AVG(e."cost") AS average_cost
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE m."first_name" = 'Elijah'
  AND m."last_name" = 'Allen'
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e."expense_date"::date) IN (9, 10);

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)::NUMERIC AS ratio
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement';

SELECT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
JOIN "member" m ON m."member_id" = a."link_to_member"
WHERE e."type" = 'Social'
  AND m."position" = 'Vice President'
  AND e."location" = '900 E. Washington St.';

SELECT DISTINCT m."first_name", m."last_name", a."link_to_event"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE e."approved" = 'true'
  AND e."expense_date"::date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT e."event_name", e."event_date"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
JOIN "expense" ex ON ex."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE ex."expense_description" = 'Pizza'
  AND ex."cost"::NUMERIC > 50
  AND ex."cost"::NUMERIC < 100;

SELECT m."first_name", m."last_name", e."cost"
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "budget" b ON e."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE e."link_to_member" IN (
    SELECT e2."link_to_member"
    FROM "expense" e2
    JOIN "budget" b2 ON e2."link_to_budget" = b2."budget_id"
    GROUP BY e2."link_to_member"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2."link_to_event") > 1
)
ORDER BY e."cost"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.cost
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, i.amount
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE i.date_received = '2019-09-09';
